Method of Attack: Unicode steganography using invisible Unicode characters to hide malicious code and Google Calendar links for command-and-control (C2) communication
eval() function used to execute the payload
persistence mechanism in the system's temporary directory
Impacted Systems: Node.js systems that use the os-info-checker-es6 package and its dependencies
Attack Vector: Dependency injection through malicious NPM packages
Indicators of Compromise: Google Calendar short link used for C2 communication
base64-encoded URL in the data-base-title attribute of a Google Calendar event's HTML page
HTTP headers containing initialization vector and secret key
